name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Adopt Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct as EXCAVA’s primary inference engine. Its MoE design delivers 235B active parameters with 22B experts, hitting a sweet spot between raw scale and efficiency—beating DeepSeek-R1-671B on throughput without sacrificing reasoning depth. The trade-off is higher memory overhead, but the model’s native long-context support (up to 128K tokens) offsets that by reducing pre-processing overhead.

name: Torque
text: Qwen3-235B-A22B’s MoE routing overhead will spike EXCAVA’s latency at scale—its 22B experts demand real-time gating decisions that DeepSeek-R1-671B avoids with static routing. Use DeepSeek-R1-671B on Cerebras CS-3 instead; its per-token cost is fixed, and the model’s proven throughput beats Qwen3’s peak claims. Benchmark both on EXCAVA’s live traffic—if DeepSeek’s 95th-percentile latency stays under 1.5x baseline, it wins.

name: Gearbox
text:
Adopt DeepSeek-R1-671B as EXCAVA’s primary inference engine. Its dense 671B parameter stack delivers consistent latency at scale, avoiding the MoE routing spikes Torque flagged—critical for EXCAVA’s real-time demands. The trade-off is higher per-token compute cost, but the model’s proven throughput on Cerebras CS-3 offsets this with faster overall job completion.

name: Torque
text: DeepSeek-R1-671B’s fixed per-token cost on Cerebras CS-3 will still drown EXCAVA in bills—its 671B dense stack demands 4x the compute of Qwen3-235B-A22B for marginal gains. Switch to Qwen3-235B-A22B and accept the latency spike; then profile it under EXCAVA’s real load—if the gating overhead exceeds 150ms per request, we revert to DeepSeek-R1-671B.

name: Dynamo
text: DECISION: Run a 48-hour blind A/B stress test on EXCAVA’s 8xA100 node comparing Qwen3-235B-A22B (MoE) vs DeepSeek-R1-671B (dense) under real EXCAVA load—latency, throughput, and cost per token must be measured; Torque owns the test and publishes raw results by EOD Friday.
